company.name: Qanooni
company.shortDescription: Qanooni is a legal technology company offering an AI-powered platform designed specifically for lawyers and legal professionals.
company.description:
Qanooni is an AI-powered legal technology platform purpose-built by lawyers for lawyers, designed to seamlessly integrate into familiar tools like Microsoft Word and Outlook. The platform enhances legal workflows by embedding intelligent assistance directly within the environments legal professionals use every day.

Qanooni’s personalized AI adapts to each firm’s unique style, standards, and drafting preferences, enabling lawyers to work more efficiently while maintaining consistency and quality across legal documents. By integrating with a firm’s document management systems, the platform unlocks access to institutional knowledge, precedents, and preferred language, making legal research and drafting faster and more effective.

From generating first drafts and reviewing contracts to identifying clauses and searching for precise legal language, Qanooni supports end-to-end legal workflows with legally trained AI tailored specifically for the legal profession. The platform empowers legal teams to improve productivity, reduce repetitive work, and consistently produce high-quality legal outputs aligned with firm standards.
